q: What is the CodeAlpha AI internship?
a: It is a program that gives students hands-on experience in AI model development, machine learning workflows and real-time data processing, with expert mentorship on real projects.

You get an internship offer letter, a QR-verified completion certificate, a unique ID certificate, a letter of recommendation (based on performance), job and placement support, and resume building support.

q: How many tasks do I need to complete?
a: You must complete a minimum of 2 or 3 tasks out of the 4 listed. Submitting only one task is considered incomplete and no certificate is issued.

q: What are the AI tasks I can choose from?
a: The four tasks are: Language Translation Tool, Chatbot for FAQs, Music Generation with AI, and Object Detection and Tracking.

q: How should I name my GitHub repository (repo)?
a: Name it CodeAlpha_ProjectName, for example CodeAlpha_LanguageTranslator, and upload your complete source code to it.

q: Do I need to post on LinkedIn?
a: Yes. Share your internship status on LinkedIn tagging @CodeAlpha, and post a video explanation of each project with your GitHub repo link.

q: How do I submit my completed task?
a: Use the submission form that is shared in your WhatsApp group. Tasks are accepted only through that form, so follow its instructions carefully.
Yes, if you complete the minimum number of tasks. The completion certificate is QR verified and you also receive a unique ID certificate.

q: Can I get a letter of recommendation?
a: Yes. A letter of recommendation is given based on your performance during the internship.

q: Is there placement or job support?
a: Yes. CodeAlpha offers job opportunities and placement support, plus resume building support, as part of the internship perks.

q: What should I use for the language translation task?
a: Build a UI where users enter text and pick source and target languages, then call a translation API such as Google Translate or Microsoft Translator and show the result. A copy button or text-to-speech is a nice extra.

q: How do I build the FAQ chatbot task?
a: Collect FAQs on a topic, preprocess the text with NLTK or SpaCy, match user questions to the most similar FAQ using cosine similarity or intent matching, and show the best answer. A simple chat UI is optional.

q: What do I need for the music generation task?
a: Collect MIDI data, turn it into note sequences with music21, train an LSTM or GAN model, generate new sequences and convert them to MIDI or audio.

q: What do I need for the object detection and tracking task?
a: Use OpenCV for webcam or video input, a pre-trained model like YOLO or Faster R-CNN for detection, SORT or Deep SORT for tracking, and display boxes with labels and tracking IDs in real time.
